model.name: ADM1
model.description: Modular Python implementation of the Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 (ADM1) in its BSM2 form, configured through YAML files, with optional hybrid (ML) plug points.
references: Batstone D.J. et al. (2002). Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 (ADM1). IWA Scientific and Technical Report No. 13.
Rosen C., Jeppsson U. (2006). Aspects on ADM1 implementation within the BSM2 framework. Lund University.
Sadrimajd P. et al. (2021). PyADM1: a Python implementation of Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1. https://github.com/CaptainFerMag/PyADM1

scenario.name: Tatiana_RM_lab_5L
scenario.description: Tatiana's 5 L lab digester, 193 d (from 2023-03-15), daily feed with dynamic flow, feed characterised in X_ch/X_pr/X_li/X_I, calibrated kinetics of RM_without_Xc/parameters_dyn.txt. Reproduces the RM_without_Xc notebook run AS IS (T_op fixed at 35 C although the data are at 39 C - that is what the original code does). Cross-test: python tests/compare_tatiana_rm.py --results results/dynamic_out.csv

parameters.name: N_xc
parameters.description: Nitrogen content of composite particulate matter (0.0376/14)

parameters.name: C_xc
parameters.description: Carbon content of composite particulate matter

parameters.name: f_fa_li
parameters.description: Lipid fraction converted to fatty acids

parameters.name: f_h2_aa
parameters.description: H2 fraction produced from amino acids

parameters.name: f_va_aa
parameters.description: Valerate fraction produced from amino acids

parameters.name: f_bu_aa
parameters.description: Butyrate fraction produced from amino acids

parameters.name: f_pro_aa
parameters.description: Propionate fraction produced from amino acids

parameters.name: f_ac_aa
parameters.description: Acetate fraction produced from amino acids

parameters.name: use_xc
parameters.description: 1 = with composite X_xc and disintegration (BSM2); 0 = without (Batstone 2015)

parameters.name: f_sI_xb
parameters.description: Soluble-inert fraction of decayed biomass (use_xc = 0 only)

parameters.name: f_ch_xb
parameters.description: Carbohydrate fraction of decayed biomass (use_xc = 0 only)

parameters.name: f_pr_xb
parameters.description: Protein fraction of decayed biomass (use_xc = 0 only)

parameters.name: f_li_xb
parameters.description: Lipid fraction of decayed biomass (use_xc = 0 only)

parameters.name: f_xI_xb
parameters.description: Particulate-inert fraction of decayed biomass (use_xc = 0 only)

parameters.name: gas_law_patm
parameters.description: 0 = BSM2 overpressure law k_p(P_gas - P_atm); 1 = headspace at P_atm (Batstone 2002)
parameters.override_note: Headspace at P_atm: same q_gas law as RM_without_Xc (k_p not used)

parameters.name: k_m_aa
parameters.description: Maximum uptake rate for amino acids

parameters.name: k_m_fa
parameters.description: Maximum uptake rate for fatty acids

parameters.name: pH_UL_aa
parameters.description: Upper pH limit for amino-acid degraders

parameters.name: pH_LL_aa
parameters.description: Lower pH limit for amino-acid degraders

parameters.name: pH_UL_ac
parameters.description: Upper pH limit for acetate degraders

parameters.name: pH_LL_ac
parameters.description: Lower pH limit for acetate degraders

parameters.name: pH_UL_h2
parameters.description: Upper pH limit for hydrogen degraders

parameters.name: pH_LL_h2
parameters.description: Lower pH limit for hydrogen degraders

parameters.name: K_I_h2_fa
parameters.description: H2 inhibition constant for fatty acids

parameters.name: K_w
parameters.description: Water dissociation constant at operating temperature
parameters.override_note: recomputed by the model code before integration

parameters.name: K_a_co2
parameters.description: Acid-base equilibrium constant for CO2/HCO3- at operating temperature
parameters.override_note: recomputed by the model code before integration

parameters.name: K_a_IN
parameters.description: Acid-base equilibrium constant for NH4+/NH3 at operating temperature
parameters.override_note: recomputed by the model code before integration

parameters.name: k_A_B_IN
parameters.description: Association rate constant for inorganic nitrogen

parameters.name: T_op
parameters.override_note: 35 C as hard-coded in the original code (data are at 39 C)

influent.description: Tatiana lab digester 5 L - daily feed, dynamic flow Q(t), influent in X_ch/X_pr/X_li/X_I

variables.name: charge_residual
variables.label: Charge-balance residual
variables.description: Electroneutrality residual of the acid-base solver (should be ~0)

variables.name: COD_total_with_gas
variables.label: Liquid + gas COD (sum)
variables.description: Sum of concentrations only; NOT a conservative mass inventory

variables.name: q_gas
variables.label: Biogas flow (wet, T_op, P_gas)
variables.description: Wet biogas flow at T_op and headspace pressure (the flow used in the ODE)

variables.name: q_gas_norm_dry
variables.label: Biogas flow (dry, normal)
variables.description: Dry biogas at 0 C and 1.01325 bar

variables.name: q_ch4_norm_dry
variables.label: Methane flow (dry, normal)
variables.description: Dry CH4 at 0 C and 1.01325 bar (x 1e6 -> NmL/d)
